title: AFI.------ACC.FT.
description: Second diagram on page 234 (T(IMP)M-32), paired with AF-POST × TRS above. Where the first diagram structurally shows the upper-diagonal route through which affinity-postulation routes into American-umbrella reception, this one names what affinity-insight meets when accelerated-functionalism is the working partner — the deeper structural mechanism of the 'retardation of sensibilities' the prose names: AFI (affinity insight) crossed with ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism — the partner-axis's working acceleration). AFI sits on the left with the subject-arrow; SG (source-generation) at upper-center and APP-DT (applied dictates) at upper-right with TR-INFO (transformation-information) below as the partner-side upper outputs. C-RH (central rhythm) sits centrally. SPT-DY (spectacle dynamics) at center-right with RT-DY (reality dynamics) below and PART (participation) and BIA (bias) on the right as the partner-side downward chain. ACC-FT sits at center-left as partner-axis. DEC (decision) hangs at the lower-left and DIS-C-CT (disconnect) sits centrally with RT-ALGN (reality alignment) at the bottom-center as the bridging-axis downward terminus. Structural argument: when affinity-insight is crossed with accelerated-functionalism, the upper diagonal SG → APP-DT → TR-INFO is the *applied-dictates route* — source-generation routes through applied-dictates into transformation-information, the partner-side's working chain that converts AFI's insight into the receiving culture's transformational-information. C-RH → SPT-DY → RT-DY → PART → BIA is the central-and-right chain — central-rhythm routes through spectacle-dynamics into reality-dynamics, then through participation into bias, the partner-axis's downward-right working. ACC-FT → DEC is what accelerated-functionalism produces alone — decision. DIS-C-CT → RT-ALGN is the bridging-bottom chain: disconnect routes into reality-alignment. The structural argument: the 'retardation of sensibilities' the prose names is structurally the DIS-C-CT → RT-ALGN bridging-bottom chain — affinity-insight's working continuance is disconnected from reality-alignment at exactly the bridging-axis terminus, while the upper diagonal SG → APP-DT → TR-INFO continues to route into the partner-side's working transformational-information. The form's actual insight reaches reality-alignment only through disconnect; accelerated-functionalism produces decision without integration — the working sensibilities are retarded by the structural disconnect at the bridging-terminus.
